sections.title: Pros
sections.narration: Pros first: dark meat stays flavorful and forgiving to cook. That makes chicken thigh easier to use well in real meals than drier leaner cuts. Helps make meals feel complete. That practical meal role matters beyond the score rows. Easy to build complete meals around. It works as an actual centrepiece protein rather than a garnish ingredient.
